```{r, include=FALSE}
library(DiagrammeR)

# layer = "base" : main flow only (always visible)
# layer = "note" : just note n + its arrow
# layer = "hl"   : just the step(s) being explained, highlighted
manual_diagram <- function(layer = "base", n = 0) {

  # Which nodes / edges are highlighted for each note
  hl_nodes <- list(`1` = "A", `2` = "B", `3` = "C", `4` = "E")
  hl_edges <- list(`2` = "AB", `3` = "CE")   # note 2 also lights up "Select date & type",
                                             # note 3 also lights up "Target article webpage"
  is_hl_node <- function(id) layer == "hl" && id %in% hl_nodes[[as.character(n)]]
  is_hl_edge <- function(id) layer == "hl" && id %in% hl_edges[[as.character(n)]]

  # Node attributes: normal in base, highlighted when active, invisible otherwise
  node_attrs <- function(id, label, fill, col, pw) {
    if (layer == "base") {
      sprintf("label = '%s', fillcolor = '%s', color = '%s', penwidth = %s", label, fill, col, pw)
    } else if (is_hl_node(id)) {
      sprintf("label = '%s', fillcolor = '#FEF9C3', color = '#000000', penwidth = 5", label)
    } else {
      sprintf("label = '%s', style = 'invis'", label)
    }
  }

  # Edge attributes: normal in base, highlighted when active, invisible otherwise
  edge_attrs <- function(id, label = NULL) {
    lab <- if (is.null(label)) "" else sprintf("label = '%s', ", label)
    if (layer == "base") {
      sub(", $", "", lab)
    } else if (is_hl_edge(id)) {
      paste0(lab, "color = '#000000', fontcolor = '#000000', penwidth = 3.5")
    } else {
      paste0(lab, "style = 'invis'")
    }
  }

  # Notes and their arrows: only visible in their own "note" layer
  note  <- function(k) if (layer == "note" && n == k) "style = '', fontcolor = '#000000'" else "style = 'invis'"
  arrow <- function(k) if (layer == "note" && n == k) "color = '#000000', penwidth = 2.5, arrowhead = vee" else "style = 'invis'"

  dot <- paste0("
digraph manual_steps {
  graph [
    rankdir = TB,
    bgcolor = transparent,
    nodesep = 0.5,
    ranksep = 0.4,
    pad = 0.1
  ]

  node [
    shape = box,
    style = 'rounded,filled',
    fillcolor = '#F8FAFC',
    color = '#64748B',
    penwidth = 2.5,
    fontname = 'Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif',
    fontsize = 30,
    fontcolor = '#1E293B',
    margin = '0.35,0.2'
  ]

  edge [
    fontname = 'Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif',
    fontsize = 26,
    fontcolor = '#2563EB',
    color = '#94A3B8',
    arrowsize = 1.2,
    penwidth = 2.5
  ]

  A [", node_attrs('A', 'ETtoday website\\n(list of articles)', '#F8FAFC', '#64748B', 2.5), "]
  B [", node_attrs('B', 'Filtered articles', '#EFF6FF', '#3B82F6', 3), "]
  C [", node_attrs('C', 'Click on title of target article', '#F8FAFC', '#64748B', 2.5), "]
  E [", node_attrs('E', 'Copy title, date, and content\\ninto Excel / Word', '#F0FDF4', '#22C55E', 3), "]

  Note1 [
    label = 'Store the web address as a variable\\l',
    shape = plaintext, fontsize = 26, margin = '0.35,0.05', ", note(1), "
  ]
  Note2 [
    label = '• Store dates and types as variables\\l• Paste variables to create web addresses\\l• Let R read web pages that list the addresses of\\l   individual articles, and store these addresses\\l',
    shape = plaintext, fontsize = 26, margin = '0.35,0.05', ", note(2), "
  ]
  Note3 [
    label = '• Identify the links to the individual articles\\l• Read the structure of the webpages of\\l   individual articles\\l',
    shape = plaintext, fontsize = 26, margin = '0.35,0.05', ", note(3), "
  ]
  Note4 [
    label = '• Identify the nodes corresponding to the title,\\l   date and content of the article\\l• Store them as variables\\l• Combine variables of the same article\\l   into a data frame\\l• Save the data frame and export to an Excel file\\l',
    shape = plaintext, fontsize = 26, margin = '0.35,0.05', ", note(4), "
  ]

  { rank = same; Note1; A }
  { rank = same; B; Note2 }
  { rank = same; Note3; C }
  { rank = same; E; Note4 }

  A -> B [", edge_attrs('AB', ' Select date & type '), "]
  B -> C [", edge_attrs('BC'), "]
  C -> E [", edge_attrs('CE', ' Target article webpage '), "]

  Note1 -> A [dir = back, ", arrow(1), "]
  B -> Note2 [", arrow(2), "]
  Note3 -> C [dir = back, ", arrow(3), "]
  E -> Note4 [", arrow(4), "]
}
")

  grViz(dot, width = "100%", height = "650px")
}
```

## 4. Let's get R to do the job for us!

## Preliminary step: Libraries needed

For this task, we will only need four packages:

```{r, echo = TRUE}
library(rvest)    
library(dplyr)     
library(xml2)      
library(openxlsx)
library(progress)
```

## Step 1: Record the web addresses

Generate web addresses that list individual articles based on filters:

- **Base address:** `https://www.ettoday.net/news/news-list`
- **Filtered pattern:** `[Base] - [Date] - [Category] .htm`

First, let's paste a single date and category together:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
ETTodayPageUrl <- "https://www.ettoday.net/news/news-list" 

Year <- 2024
Month <- 10
Day <- 28

date <- paste0(Year, "-", Month, "-", Day)
category <- 1 # 1 = Politics
```

## Pasting the full URL

We use `paste0()` to stitch the URL together:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
URL <- paste0(ETTodayPageUrl,
              "-",
              date,
              "-",
              category,
              ".htm")
URL
```


## Automating with "for loops"

To generate links for the whole year, we use a **for loop**. Every loop has three basic components:

1. **The List:** The group of items you want to work through.

2. **The Action:** The specific job you want to do for a single item.

3. **The Loop:** The process that automatically repeats the action for the next item.


## Creating the Dates Loop

We nest loops for Days, Months, and Years to generate all dates:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
Dates_total <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 1, nrow = 0))
Year <- 2024
Month <- 1:12
Day <- 1:31

for (a in 1:length(Day)){
  for (b in 1:length(Month)){
    for (c in min(Year):max(Year)){
      Dates <- paste0(c, "-", b, "-", a)
      Dates <- as.data.frame(Dates)
      Dates_total <- rbind(Dates_total, Dates)
    }
  }
}

Dates_total <- as.character(Dates_total$Dates)

head(Dates_total, 5)
```

## Adding the Categories

Next, we attach our categories (e.g., Society & Politics) to our list of dates:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
Category_total <- c("6", "1") # 6 = Society, 1 = Politics
URL_total <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 1, nrow = 0))
  
for (a in 1:length(Category_total)){
  URL_temp <- paste0(ETTodayPageUrl, "-", Dates_total, "-", Category_total[a], ".htm")
  URL_temp <- as.data.frame(URL_temp)
  URL_total <- rbind(URL_total, URL_temp)
}

URL_total <- as.character(URL_total$URL_temp)
head(URL_total, 5)
```

## Step 2: Retrieve individual article URLs


::: {style="display: flex; justify-content: center; margin-top: 2.5em;"}
::: {.fragment style="max-width: 820px; padding: 36px 44px; background-color: #eef5fb; border-left: 6px solid #447099; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-size: 1.15em; line-height: 1.6; text-align: left;"}
Take 5 minutes to recall ***where and how*** you found the links in ***the structure of the website***.
:::
:::

## Step 2: Let's do it automatically

::: {.callout-important}
Always try with one page first!
:::

Now that we have the list of pages, we extract the links to the *individual* articles using `rvest`:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=TRUE}
# Read the first page
IndPage <- read_html(URL_total[1])

# Extract specific href links
news_url <- IndPage %>% 
  html_nodes("div.part_list_2") %>% 
  html_nodes("h3") %>%
  html_nodes("a") %>%
  html_attr("href")

news_url
```

## Looping through all pages

We repeat this extraction across our entire `URL_total` list:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
URL_IndArticles <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 1, nrow = 0))

for (i in 1:length(URL_total)){
  IndPage <- read_html(URL_total[i])
  news_url <- IndPage %>% 
    html_nodes("div.part_list_2") %>% 
    html_nodes("h3") %>%
    html_nodes("a") %>%
    html_attr("href")
  
  news_url <- as.data.frame(news_url)
  URL_IndArticles <- rbind(URL_IndArticles, news_url)
}

# Remove any duplicated addresses
article_overview_unique <- unique(URL_IndArticles)
```

## Step 3: Retrieve article content


::: {style="display: flex; justify-content: center; margin-top: 2.5em;"}
::: {.fragment style="max-width: 820px; padding: 36px 44px; background-color: #eef5fb; border-left: 6px solid #447099; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-size: 1.15em; line-height: 1.6; text-align: left;"}
Take 5 minutes to recall ***where and how*** you found the content of the article in ***the structure of the website***.
:::
:::

## Step 3: Let's do it automatically

We map nodes to extract the specific text (date, title, body) from an individual article:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
OneArticle <- read_html(article_overview_unique$news_url[1])

# time of news
news_time <- OneArticle %>% 
  html_nodes("time") %>% 
  html_text(trim = TRUE)

# class of news
news_class <- OneArticle %>% 
  html_nodes(".part_menu_5") %>% 
  html_nodes("strong") %>%
  html_text(trim = TRUE)

# title 
news_title <- OneArticle %>% 
  html_nodes("h1") %>% 
  html_text(trim = TRUE)

# content 
news_body <- OneArticle %>% 
  html_nodes('div[itemprop="articleBody"]') %>% 
  html_text(trim = TRUE)

article <- (data.frame(time = news_time,
                       class = news_class,
                       title = news_title,
                       body = news_body,
                       url = article_overview_unique$news_url[1]))

head(article)
```

## Scrape through all the pages with For Loop

When scraping thousands of pages, broken links happen. We wrap our loop in `tryCatch()` so R skips errors instead of crashing completely:

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
Article_total <- data.frame()

for (j in 1:length(article_overview_unique$news_url)){

    temp <- read_html(article_overview_unique$news_url[j])
    
    # time of news
    news_time <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes("time") %>% 
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # class of news
    news_class <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes(".part_menu_5") %>% 
      html_nodes("strong") %>%
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # title 
    news_title <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes("h1") %>% 
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # content 
    news_body <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes('div[itemprop="articleBody"]') %>% 
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # url
    news_url <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes("div.block div.block_content div.part_list_2 h3") %>% 
      html_nodes("a") %>%
      html_attr("href")
    
    Article <- (data.frame(time = news_time,
                           class = news_class,
                           title = news_title,
                           body = news_body,
                           url = article_overview_unique$news_url[j]))
    Article_total <- rbind(Article_total, Article))
  
}
```

## How to prevent crashes?

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
Article_total <- data.frame()


for (j in 1:length(article_overview_unique$news_url)){
  
  tryCatch({
    temp <- read_html(article_overview_unique$news_url[j])
    
    # time of news
    news_time <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes("time") %>% 
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # class of news
    news_class <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes(".part_menu_5") %>% 
      html_nodes("strong") %>%
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # title 
    news_title <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes("h1") %>% 
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # content 
    news_body <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes('div[itemprop="articleBody"]') %>% 
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # url
    news_url <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes("div.block div.block_content div.part_list_2 h3") %>% 
      html_nodes("a") %>%
      html_attr("href")
    
    Article <- (data.frame(time = news_time,
                           class = news_class,
                           title = news_title,
                           body = news_body,
                           url = article_overview_unique$news_url[j]))
    Article_total <- rbind(Article_total, Article)
  }, error=function(e){message("ERROR :",conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
  
}
```

## Progress bar and "sleep" time

```{r, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
Article_total <- data.frame()

## Set the progress bar

total_urls <- length(article_overview_unique$news_url)
pb <- progress_bar$new(
  format = "  Scraping [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) | ETA: :eta",
  total = total_urls, 
  clear = FALSE, 
  width = 60
)


for (j in 1:length(article_overview_unique$news_url)){
  
  pb$tick()
  
  tryCatch({
    temp <- read_html(article_overview_unique$news_url[j])
    
    # time of news
    news_time <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes("time") %>% 
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # class of news
    news_class <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes(".part_menu_5") %>% 
      html_nodes("strong") %>%
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # title 
    news_title <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes("h1") %>% 
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # content 
    news_body <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes('div[itemprop="articleBody"]') %>% 
      html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    # url
    news_url <- temp %>% 
      html_nodes("div.block div.block_content div.part_list_2 h3") %>% 
      html_nodes("a") %>%
      html_attr("href")
    
    Article <- (data.frame(time = news_time,
                           class = news_class,
                           title = news_title,
                           body = news_body,
                           url = article_overview_unique$news_url[j]))
    Article_total <- rbind(Article_total, Article)
  }, error=function(e){pb$message("ERROR :",conditionMessage(e), "\n")})
  
}


testit <- function(x = sort(runif(20)), ...)
{
    pb <- txtProgressBar(...)
    for(i in c(0, x, 1)) {Sys.sleep(0.5); setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)}
    Sys.sleep(1)
    close(pb)
}
```

## Step 4: Save the Data

Finally, we export the scraped dataset to both an Excel document and a native RData workspace file:

```r
# Export to Excel for human readability
write.xlsx(Article_total, "ArticleETToday_CorpusCourse.xlsx")

# Save as RData object
save(Article_total, file = "ArticleETToday_CorpusCourse.Rdata")
```
